verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents its own access review capability: a docs page titled "Perform Access Review for a Critical System", an "Monitor Access Checks" page, and integrations that map users with access to connected systems. The pack gives only page titles and an integration snippet, so the depth of the workflow is unproven. missing for 10: evidence that reviews run on a periodic or recurring schedule, coverage across all connected apps rather than one critical system, in-app reviewer sign-off, review artifacts landing in an evidence library, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, periodic user access reviews run across connected apps in the platform — reviewers sign off in-app and the artifact lands in the evidence library

citations.quote: Perform Access Review for a Critical System | Sprinto Docs
It helps Sprinto to map and check if the user with access offboards the organization.
